outcome: microbial invasion of the amniotic cavity (MIAC)
cohort: The study included 252 women with singleton pregnancies who presented with preterm labor between 24 and 31 weeks of gestation and underwent transabdominal amniocentesis.
finding: Elevated levels of kallistatin, MMP-2, TGFBI, and uPA, and low levels of lumican and SPARC in the amniotic fluid were significantly associated with imminent spontaneous preterm birth, intra-amniotic inflammation, and microbial invasion of the amniotic cavity.
